changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwbillingallocation AS SELECT ba.id, ba.allocation_number, ba.charge_id, ba.charge_line_id, ba.charge_responsibility_id, ba.patient_service_product_id, ba.patient_id, ba.encounter_id, ba.allocation_source_type, ba.reservation_id, ba.payment_id, ba.payment_transaction_id, ba.debit_transaction_id, ba.source_reference_type, ba.source_reference_id, ba.source_reference_number, ba.allocated_amount, ba.remaining_allocated_amount, ba.reversed_amount, ba.currency, ba.status, ba.allocation_date, ba.reversed_date, ba.reversed_by, ba.reversal_reason, ba.original_allocation_id, ba.idempotency_key, ba.transaction_group_id, ba.notes, ba.created_by, ba.created_date, ba.last_modified_by, ba.last_modified_date FROM public.billing_allocation ba;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwbillingallocation TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwbillingallocation FROM report_user;
